risks.title: Fluctuations in yen/dollar foreign exchange rates
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned prominently in the Risk Factors section and detailed extensively in Item 7A. The company is significantly exposed through its Japan operations and substantial yen-denominated investments. Exchange rate fluctuations directly impact the translation of yen-denominated assets/liabilities into USD for reporting, and the company notes potential for significant cash strain at the parent company level from derivative settlements and collateral requirements. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Due to the size of Aflac Japan, where the functional currency is the Japanese yen". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.description: Fluctuations in the yen/dollar exchange rate impact the value of Aflac Japan's yen-denominated assets and liabilities when translated to USD for financial reporting, and can create significant liquidity requirements for derivative settlements and collateral, particularly during yen strengthening periods.

risks.score_rationale: The company's Japan segment generates the vast majority of earnings and the investment portfolio shows significant concentration in yen-denominated securities. The MD&A indicates that Aflac Japan's functional currency is the yen and a material portion of the portfolio supports yen-denominated liabilities, creating concentration risk. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "The Company expects Aflac Japan to generate an expense ratio in the range of 20%". Position: haut Item 1A.

risks.title: Derivative and hedging program risks
risks.score_rationale: Item 7A details extensive use of foreign currency forwards, options, and other derivatives for hedging purposes. The company acknowledges rollover risk, basis risk, and the potential for significant derivative losses during periods of yen movement. The company notes explicit risks from shorter-duration derivatives hedging longer-duration investments. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "The Company expects Aflac Japan to generate an expense ratio in the range of 20%". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.description: Aflac uses foreign currency derivatives and hedging instruments to manage currency exposure, but these instruments introduce rollover risk, collateral requirements, and potential settlement losses, particularly during volatile currency movements.

risks.title: Liquidity strain from foreign exchange derivatives settlement
risks.score_rationale: Item 7A explicitly states that if yen strengthens significantly, this could cause cash strain at the parent company from derivative cash settlements and collateral requirements, and notes this could be significant depending on timing and severity of rate movements. The company manages this through ongoing hedging program adjustments. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "The Company also excludes from adjusted earnings the accounting impacts of foreign currency remeasurement associated". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.description: Aflac's use of foreign currency derivatives to hedge yen exposure can create significant temporary liquidity demands at the parent company level during periods of yen strengthening, requiring cash for collateral and settlement obligations.
